knownLimits: Gemini painted the supraorbital notch as a short groove running up from the rim (and the supratrochlear as a smaller one); with the code-drawn nerves exiting through them they read as notches. The needle tip was lifted to 7 mm above the rim so it sits clear of the painted groove. The supratrochlear's position about 12 mm medial to the notch is standard anatomy added; the record says only 'slightly medial'.
